claim_a.text: The current stable line is v0.9.1.

claim_b.text: Older examples and project notes imply v0.8 or an unspecified preview.

contradictions.resolution: Pin v0.9.1 and treat v1 as a candidate.
contradictions.audit_trail: Current official specification outranks older preview-era project assumptions.

claim_b.text: Protocol support implies the integration can be called stable.

contradictions.resolution: Protocol interoperability may be demonstrated, but the genui integration remains experimental.
contradictions.audit_trail: Upstream explicitly labels the SDK highly experimental.

claim_a.text: One Tauri 2 codebase targets desktop and mobile.

claim_b.text: One successful desktop build proves store-ready mobile distribution.

contradictions.resolution: Certify shared code and platform builds separately; signing/notarization/store publication require their own evidence and authority.
contradictions.audit_trail: Official distribution docs enumerate platform signing requirements.

claim_a.text: Screenshots and video are useful review receipts.

contradictions.resolution: Assertions and machine results establish behavior; visuals support review and diagnosis.
contradictions.audit_trail: Playwright documents environment-sensitive visual comparison and richer trace diagnostics.
